 Deadline approaches to apply for state Property Tax/Rent Rebate for 2025.
"/> 
 Dec. 31 deadline approaches to apply for state Property Tax/Rent Rebate 
 By Indiana Gazette 
 Nov 6, 2026 
 11 hrs ago 
 Facebook 
 Twitter

 SMS

 Save 
 State lawmakers, including Reps. Jim Struzzi, R-Indiana; Brian Smith, R-Punxsutawney; and Josh Bashline, R-Clarion, are advising in their constituent emails this week that eligible senior citizens and Pennsylvanians with disabilities have until Dec. 31 to apply for rebates on rent and property taxes paid in 2025.
 They said income limits for the Property Tax/Rent Rebate Program increased again this year to $48,110 for both homeowners and renters. They urged potential applicants to remember to exclude 50% of Social Security when determining income.
